Subject: MAP: NimbleHealth hosting & region decision — eval updates

Hi Alice / Marta,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is MAP_v3 (nimble_MAP_v3.xlsx) with the updated evaluation plan and a short hosting comparison (redwood_hosting_comparison.pdf). Key changes are:

- Narrowed eval to two pilots: Hosted (fast onboarding) vs Dedicated (reserved capacity).
- Short checklist for Private (on-prem) if regulatory gating appears during SOC/contract review.
- Proposed dates: 6/14–6/25 for short PoC runs, decision checkpoint on 6/28.

What we need from you to keep the MAP on-track:
1) Confirm if Nimble is comfortable running the PoC in our US-hosted region or requires a Dedicated pool for data isolation.
2) Procurement: any mandatory vendor terms / additional security paperwork needed before 6/10? (Marta, looping you)
3) A single prioritized evaluation scenario (recommendation in cell B12 of the MAP).

If it's helpful we can cut the PoC to a 5-business-day smoke test to validate latency and cost pro forma before expanding.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm hosting preference (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) by EOD 6/10.
- We set a 30-min Go/No-go on 6/11 to lock the PoC runway.

Attachments: nimble_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP + milestone Gantt), redwood_hosting_comparison.pdf (tradeoffs + cost sheet).

Thanks,
Laura Bennett

Subject: Re: MAP: NimbleHealth hosting & region decision — eval updates

Hi Laura — thanks for the MAP and the summary. Quick answers:

- Prefer Hosted to start (fastest), but we need to confirm data residency for PII; if we see any blocking controls from our security team we may request Dedicated.
- Procurement: procurement@nimblehealth.com will follow up with standard PO and our vendor questionnaire. We do have a short internal DPA redline that legal will send if we move forward.

Open asks for Redwood:
- Can you confirm whether Hosted evaluation can be restricted to a single US region and if logs/audit trails are available for the PoC (duration: 10 days)?
- Any recommended guardrails for rate-limiting during the smoke test to avoid cost spikes?

Marta — I copied procurement. We need their read on timeline (can we get PO before 6/14?).

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Product Manager, NLP
NimbleHealth
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: NimbleHealth hosting & region decision — eval updates

Alice — quick clarifications from the infra side: 

1) Hosted in our US region: yes, we can pin the PoC to a single region (us-west-2). We can enable verbose audit logs for the PoC window and export a compressed bundle at the end of the run.

2) Rate-limiting: recommendation for the smoke test is to cap concurrency at 8 and set a token-budget of 500k tokens/day for the pilot. That keeps latency SLOs realistic while bounding cost. If Nimble wants lower budget we can tune the sample size while preserving measurement quality.

3) Dedicated consideration: if legal/procurement pushes on control requirements (eg. no multi-tenant metadata), Dedicated pools are typically a 2–4 week provisioning path once the SOW and resource commit are agreed. That may push the decision past your 6/28 checkpoint.

If helpful, I can add a short row in the MAP that shows expected lead time and cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private (on-prem).

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

Adding pricing/procurement notes (short):

- Hosted PoC (10 days, token cap 500k/day): estimated incremental cost = $3,100 (pro forma line in redwood_hosting_comparison.pdf). We'll credit up to $2,000 toward your evaluation if the PO references the MAP (standard MAP incentive).
- Dedicated baseline (monthly reserved): requires minimum 1 month commitment for the pool; estimated monthly cost delta vs Hosted = +$12,500 (includes reserved GPU amortized + support).
- Private / on-prem: custom quote; typical setup 6–8 weeks and onboarding fee applies.

Action for Nimble to close on pace: 
1) Procurement to issue a short PO (covering the credited PoC cost) before 6/11 to avoid provisioning delays.
2) If legal needs a DPA redline, send it to contracts@redwood.com; we can triage and provide a redline within 48 business hours for simple terms.

I attached a short exported cost table in the comparison PDF for quick reference.

— Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Great — thanks for the quick replies, everyone. Finalizing the MAP timeline given today's clarifications: 

- PoC window: 6/14–6/25 in us-west-2 (Hosted) with audit logs enabled.
- Budget cap for the pilot: 500k tokens/day unless you request a different cap.
- If procurement can provide PO referencing MAP by COB 6/11 we will:
  • Reserve the Hosted test environment and schedule onboarding slot on 6/13.
  • Apply $2,000 evaluation credit to your invoice.

If procurement/legal surface a hard blocker on multi-tenancy, we will scope a Dedicated pilot but need a 2–4 week provisioning notice — that moves the decision checkpoint to 7/12.

Please reply-all to confirm PO timing and whether you accept the pilot dates. I'll book the 30-min Go/No-go on 6/11 09:00 PT unless you request another time.

Thanks again — looking forward to closing this MAP together.
